scope: The 22 healthcare, Medicare, emergency and workplace safety/compensation URLs in the original restricted/network-error baseline. Reference line numbers come from that immutable baseline.

reviews.title: Notify WorkSafe
reviews.note: The public guidance separates a PCBU/authorised manager's statutory incident notification from a worker's safety concern. Personal compensation is a separate process.

reviews.title: Injuries and claims
reviews.note: Worker claim form, chosen doctor's capacity certificate, employer/insurer handoff and retention of invoices/receipts are present. The linked journey exception is not treated as universal cover.

reviews.title: Employees and other workers
reviews.note: Browser confirms WHS worker duties and links to roles in the claims process and making a workers compensation claim. WHS worker status alone is not compensation eligibility.

reviews.title: HCSCC
reviews.note: The www hostname failed in browser with ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID. The official non-www site opens normally; its contact page confirms 1800 004 474. No certificate warning was bypassed.

reviews.title: HCSCC
reviews.note: The commission homepage identifies its SA health/community service complaint role and 1800 232 007. Its public complaint guidance links provider-first preparation and assistance.

reviews.title: Health Complaints Commissioner Tasmania
reviews.note: Homepage and complaint guidance identify Tasmanian health services as the jurisdiction, not the complainant's residence. Scope exclusions and prior provider contact remain for the agency to assess.

reviews.title: Private Health Insurance complaints
reviews.note: Official scope includes OSHC/OVHC only with Australian registered providers; excludes unregistered overseas providers, travel insurance and clinical quality. Insurer-first contact is preserved.

reviews.title: Giving feedback and making complaints
reviews.note: Official guidance links the state/territory complaint bodies and provider-first preparation. The national Commission is not itself an individual complaints service; use each body's current contact details.

reviews.title: Understanding your healthcare rights
reviews.note: Official Charter explains access, safety, respect, partnership, information, privacy and feedback. These rights are not a guarantee of Medicare eligibility or free services.

reviews.title: Notify us of a workplace incident
reviews.note: Browser confirms old route displays Page Not Found. Its own footer links the replacement with PCBU duties, notification channels and safety/site-preservation exceptions. No report submitted.

reviews.title: WHS regulators and workers' compensation authorities contact information
reviews.note: Official directory remains a jurisdiction-finding entry point, not a claims processor. QLD's provider site has newer contact details than the directory; no stale directory phone was copied.

reviews.title: Workers' compensation
reviews.note: National overview identifies separate Australian compensation schemes and states Safe Work Australia does not manage individual claims. Retained for scheme distinctions only.

reviews.title: Bulk billing
reviews.note: Medicare enrolment and provider acceptance of the benefit as full payment are distinguished. A single visit can contain bulk-billed and non-bulk-billed services; existing wording already covers this.

reviews.title: Enrolling in Medicare
reviews.note: Official eligibility/document guidance opens with a context query on the destination. Current arrival copy remains conditional; temporary visa status alone does not establish eligibility. Original useful link retained.

reviews.title: Medicare claims
reviews.note: Official page distinguishes online limits for services over two years old from alternative submission channels, and explains Closed status. Added follow-up guidance without declaring all rights expired or promising acceptance.

reviews.title: Making a claim
reviews.note: SIRA hub links initial notification, claim submission and capacity certificate guidance. Current psychological-injury changes were separately verified in the worker/employer guide, not inferred from the hub.

reviews.title: Using other emergency numbers
reviews.note: Old Triple Zero URL redirected toward infrastructure.gov.au/triple-zero and retrieval failed. Current department detail page explains 000, mobile-only 112 and TTY-only 106; replaced without claiming old URL was a 404.

reviews.title: Making a claim
reviews.note: Web retrieval was 403 but public browser displays current claim instructions, First Certificate of Capacity, employer/insurer handoff and written decision guidance. Retained; not classified as dead.

reviews.title: Incidents and notifications
reviews.note: Current WorkSafe page covers safety reporting and announces WorkCover's separate site from 10 August 2026. Kept the safety path separate from the insurer's compensation claim.

reviews.title: Making a claim
reviews.note: Current regulatory guide distinguishes WorkCover from self-insurers and requires both certificate and application. Retained the general guide while adding WorkCover's specific new claim-information page.

reviews.title: Work-related injury or illness - first steps
reviews.note: Worker care/certificate/employer contact and insurer claim are distinct from the employer's injury reporting and possible WHS notification. Public guidance updated 10 August 2026.

reviews.title: How to make a workers compensation claim as a worker
reviews.note: Official guidance describes claim form plus capacity certificate, usual six-month timing and submission before leaving employment if resigning. Illness/deafness exceptions are referred back to the authority.

supportingSources.title: How to make a claim
supportingSources.note: Public insurer guide reached from the new official homepage. Current contact 1300 927 928; a certificate arriving alone does not start a claim. Self-insurers use their own process.

supportingSources.title: Psychological injuries - a guide for workers and employers
supportingSources.note: Updated 18 August 2026. First employer-notification date, primary versus secondary injury, exempt groups and relevant-conduct form requirement bound the picker summary.

supportingSources.title: Contact us
supportingSources.note: Same official non-www domain confirms the existing NT phone; no call made.

supportingSources.title: Complaints
supportingSources.note: Official service-location scope supports choosing the jurisdiction of care, not current residence.

limits: Not a full clinical/legal review of all statements on every page.
Original automated statuses are preserved, not rewritten as HTTP successes.
No account, claim, complaint, phone call, certificate bypass, payment change or personal-data entry.
65 other baseline access-limited URLs remain for later review; two dynamic URL templates remain separately unverified.
